propositions: An s3:// ticket-store remote without a git-remote-s3 helper featuring IfNoneMatch per-ref locking leaves multiple bundles for one ref, causing store corruption that surfaces as cloning failures.
Rebar currently does not prevent pushing to s3:// remotes with missing or outdated git-remote-s3 helpers, allowing misconfiguration to corrupt the store silently rather than failing at setup.

Store operations (init and push) must detect S3 mode by resolving the remote URL scheme and fail unconditionally with OptionalDependencyError when the helper is absent or below version 0.3.2, bypassing best-effort exception handling to prevent corruption.

The S3 preflight guard must reuse existing remote-URL resolution calls (push.py:418 and init.py _git) without introducing new seams, and must apply to both synchronous and async push arms plus init to catch misconfigurations at setup time.
